title: [AUG-205] Live panel: responsive side columns that never overflow the window (UI audit T2)
why_we_need_this: UI audit AUG-203 (@docs/reviews/2026-11-ui-audit.md, findings F-01, F-02): with ACTION ITEMS + COPILOT + ASSISTANT open the columns are fixed at 300 + 300 + 380 px after a 360 px canvas, so at the default 1280×866 window the ASSISTANT column ends 76 px past the right edge (its text and SEND are cut) and at the 960×600 minimum a whole column is off-screen, the toolbar wraps to two rows and the pin-bar column toggles break into three lines. A new user does not even learn that a third panel exists.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] At 1280×866 with all three side columns open, every column (including ASSISTANT input and SEND) is fully inside the viewport; no element extends past window width (DOM check `getBoundingClientRect().right <= innerWidth`)
- [ ] When the sum of open column widths plus the 360 px canvas minimum exceeds the window, the lowest-priority column (COPILOT, then ASSISTANT) auto-collapses to its 28 px rail instead of overflowing; the user can still expand it, which collapses another
- [ ] Below ~1100 px width only one side column is shown at a time (tabs or rails) and the canvas keeps ≥ 360 px
- [ ] Live top toolbar stays on one row at 960×600 (overflow goes into a compact / overflow group) and pin-bar toggles `[ ACTION ITEMS ] [ COPILOT ] [ ASSISTANT ]` never wrap (shorter labels allowed)
- [ ] Column layout preferences in localStorage `august.liveColumns.v1.<s|m|l>` still persist per width class
- [ ] Screenshots at 960×600, 1280×866 and 1920×1040 attached to the card; Default-mode (meeting) and Live-mode panels both checked
- [ ] Both platforms unaffected at the shell level (renderer-only change)
important_constraints:
Repro screenshots: @docs/reviews/2026-11-ui-audit/94-live-panel-default.png, @docs/reviews/2026-11-ui-audit/95-live-panel-min.png. Files: client/src/components/live/LiveColumns.tsx, LiveColumn.tsx, LiveColumnToggles.tsx, client/src/services/liveColumnsStore.ts, LiveTranscriptPanel.tsx, App.css live-column rules. Keep the splitter range 240–560 px and the double-click reset. Decision for the user before starting: whether the 960×600 minimum stays (then re-flow) or rises (then only the default-size overflow needs fixing).

Order: 3/3 (UI audit AUG-203 layout follow-ups). Depends on: AUG-206 (shared `.pin-toggles` CSS). Related: AUG-204.

## Implementation (2026-11-09, commit 29692ef on master)
Decisions (user, 2026-11-09): the 960×600 minimum stays (re-flow); AUG-206 was still `new`, so this task proceeded with a minimal `.pin-toggles` touch (only `width: max-content` + `.pin-btn { white-space: nowrap }` in the AUG-199 block; the original `.pin-toggles` rule is untouched for AUG-206).

What changed (renderer-only, no platform branch):
- @client/src/services/liveColumnsStore.ts — `fitLayout()`: every layout change is fitted to the width of `.live-panel-main`; while open columns + rails + 360 px canvas exceed it, the lowest-priority expanded column collapses to its 28 px rail (COPILOT → ASSISTANT → ACTION ITEMS); below 1100 px only one column is expanded (rails act as tabs); the column the user opens is kept and the others give way; rule-collapsed columns carry `auto: true` and re-expand when room returns. Prefs still persist per width class in `august.liveColumns.v1.<s|m|l>` (now with `auto`).
- @client/src/components/LiveTranscriptPanel.tsx — ResizeObserver on `.live-panel-main` feeds the store; below 1100 px Copy All / Copy & Clear / Clear move behind `More ▾` (closes on outside click / Esc / widening) and the mute button is icon-only.
- @client/src/App.css — `.live-topbar` overflow visible (menu can drop below), `.live-more*` rules, pin bar `width: max-content` (root cause: a fixed bar at `left: 50%` shrinks-to-fit into half the viewport, hence the 3-line wrap at 960 px).

Verification (Electron dev shell on an isolated server, real window resized via Win32; DOM check `getBoundingClientRect().right <= innerWidth` over every `.live-panel *` and `.pin-toggles *` element):
| Window | Mode | Columns | Overflowing elements | Topbar / pin bar height |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 960×600 (inner 944) | Default | canvas 616, ACTION ITEMS 300, ASSISTANT rail | 0 | 48 / 37 (one row) |
| 960×600 | Live | canvas 588, ACTION ITEMS 300, COPILOT rail, ASSISTANT rail | 0 | 48 / 37 |
| 1280×866 (inner 1264) | Default | canvas 584, ACTION ITEMS 300, ASSISTANT 380 | 0 | 48 / 37 |
| 1280×866 | Live | canvas 556, ACTION ITEMS 300, COPILOT rail, ASSISTANT 380 (SEND visible) | 0 | 48 / 37 |
| 1920×1040 (inner 1904) | Default | canvas 1224, ACTION ITEMS 300, ASSISTANT 380 | 0 | 48 / 37 |
| 1920×1040 | Live | canvas 924, all three expanded | 0 | 48 / 37 |
Interactions checked: at 960 clicking the COPILOT rail expands it and ACTION ITEMS becomes a rail; clicking ASSISTANT then collapses COPILOT (canvas 508 ≥ 360); at 1280 expanding COPILOT collapses ASSISTANT; widening to 1920 re-expands ASSISTANT automatically; back at 1280 COPILOT yields again. More menu at 960 opens inside the viewport (x 204–364) with the three actions and closes on Esc. localStorage written for classes `s` and `l` during the run. tsc and `npm run build:client` pass.

Screenshots: @docs/reviews/AUG-205/default-960x600.png, @docs/reviews/AUG-205/default-1280x866.png, @docs/reviews/AUG-205/default-1920x1040.png, @docs/reviews/AUG-205/live-960x600.png, @docs/reviews/AUG-205/live-1280x866.png, @docs/reviews/AUG-205/live-1920x1040.png, @docs/reviews/AUG-205/live-960x600-assistant.png (ASSISTANT expanded, others rails), @docs/reviews/AUG-205/live-960x600-more.png (More menu open; mic muted banner visible because the run was muted to keep room audio out of the repo).

Not done / notes: macOS not run (renderer-only change; same CSS and store on both platforms). AUG-206 must keep `width: max-content` on `.pin-toggles` when it edits the bar. The splitter range and double-click reset are unchanged (code untouched).
